command:
import os
import socket
from contextlib import closing
import psycopg2
with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8081), timeout=0.5):
    pass
with closing(psycopg2.connect(
    host=os.environ["DB_HOST"], port=os.environ["DB_PORT"],
    dbname=os.environ["DB_NAME"], user=os.environ["DB_USER"],
    password=os.environ["DB_PASS"], connect_timeout=2,
    options="-c statement_timeout=1000",
)) as connection:
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT 1")
        assert cursor.fetchone() == (1,)
until pg_isready -h postgres -U quickticket -d quickticket; do sleep 2; done
initContainers.name: wait-for-postgres

command: until redis-cli -h redis ping | grep -q PONG; do sleep 2; done
initContainers.name: wait-for-redis

args:
while true; do
  curl --max-time 12 -s -o /dev/null -w 'events %{http_code} %{time_total}s\n' http://gateway:8080/events
  RES=$(curl --max-time 12 -s -X POST http://gateway:8080/events/7808/reserve \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"quantity":1}')
  RID=$(echo "$RES" | sed -n 's/.*reservation_id":"\([^"]*\).*/\1/p')
  if [ -n "$RID" ]; then
    curl --max-time 12 -s -X POST -o /dev/null -w 'pay %{http_code} %{time_total}s\n' \
      "http://gateway:8080/reserve/$RID/pay"
  else
    echo "reserve failed: $RES"
  fi
  sleep 0.3
done
containers.name: curl
